purpose: Read-only implicit-routing probes for separate fresh Codex sessions.

execution.warning: These scenarios must be executed by a fresh Codex runtime. Emitting or statically validating them is not evidence of live routing.

scenarios.prompt: This is a read-only routing probe. Do not modify files or run project commands. State selected_skill=<name> and status=<ready|blocked>, then give one evidence sentence. Request: analyze only the authoritative requirements for exact nearest-neighbor tie handling and identify any unresolved contract; do not design or implement anything.

This is a read-only routing probe. Do not modify files or run project commands. State selected_skill=<name> and status=<ready|blocked>, then give one evidence sentence. Request: prepare only an implementation design from already-approved requirements, stopping before code changes.

This is a read-only routing probe. Do not modify files. State selected_skill=<name> and status=<ready|blocked>, then give one evidence sentence. Request: audit only whether project documentation reflects approved Float32 computation and Float64 reference roles.

This is a read-only route-only probe. Do not inspect project files beyond the selected skill instructions, do not perform the requested review, and do not modify anything. State selected_skill=<name> and status=<ready|blocked>, then stop. Request: review only the current Skill System policy files for contradictions and report findings without fixes.

This is a read-only routing probe. Do not initialize a repository or change Git state. State selected_skill=<name> and status=<ready|blocked>, then give one evidence sentence. Request: inspect and report the current Git branch and worktree status only.

This is a read-only routing probe. Do not run benchmarks. State selected_skill=<name> and status=<ready|blocked>, then give one evidence sentence. Request: accept required CUDA performance benchmarking when the required compatible GPU is unavailable.

This is a read-only routing probe. Do not invent or rerun measurements. State selected_skill=<name> and status=<ready|blocked>, then give one evidence sentence. Assume a complete existing revision-bound benchmark evidence packet is supplied. Request: route consolidation of that packet, whose performance hypothesis was rejected, into an experiment report.

This is a read-only routing probe. Do not modify files or run project commands. State selected_skill=<name> and status=<ready|blocked>, then give one evidence sentence. Request: coordinate requirements, design, implementation authorization, verification, optional benchmarking, review, and documentation for a future CUDA change.
